html:
The Waranka are a Kichwa people of Bolívar province in the central highlands of Ecuador, around Guaranda, whose name comes from theirs.

Before the Inca they were one of the highland peoples near the Puruhá and Panzaleo. The Inca conquered the region in the late 1400s, and Kichwa spread as the common language. Today they are counted as one of the peoples of the Kichwa nationality of Ecuador.
sum: The Waranka are a Kichwa people of Bolívar province in the central highlands of Ecuador, around Guaranda, whose name comes from theirs.
